snippet.title: Why are anti-migrant protests growing in South Africa? | Global News Podcast
snippet.description:
Thousands of protesters have marched in major South African cities this week, demanding that undocumented migrants leave the country. 
 
Demonstrators say illegal immigration is putting pressure on jobs, public services and contributing to crime, while critics warn the protests risk fuelling xenophobia and attacks on foreign nationals. 
 
President Cyril Ramaphosa has urged protesters to remain peaceful, while acknowledging the need for immigration reform.
 
Police say 25,000 migrants, most from other African countries, have been repatriated so far.

snippet.title: Taylor Swift's rumoured wedding celebrations begin with star-studded New York event | BBC News
snippet.description:
Taylor Swift and her fiancé Travis Kelce have kicked off rumoured wedding celebrations at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
 
High-profile friends of the couple, from actress Lena Dunham to frequent collaborator Jack Antonoff were spotted Thursday evening in formal attire.
 
Aerial footage showed a stream of black SUVs pulling up to the venue with guests dropped off under a white canopy tent. Media speculation has dubbed the event both a pre-party and possible rehearsal dinner.
 
Around 100 people were expected at the event on Thursday, ahead of a much larger celebration on Friday boasting up to 1,000 guests at the arena.

Millions visited the mansion, but no one was allowed into the space above it, a locked room tied to one of the most famous lives in music history. snippet.title: He Married His Russian Muse...Then Fell For His 15-Year-Old Niece. #history #royalhistory
snippet.description:
Prince Chakrabongse Bhuvanath was born on March 3 1883. He came into the world in a massive royal family becoming the fortieth child of the great King Chulalongkorn known as Rama V. However his status was incredibly high since he was the fourth child of the principal wife of the monarch Queen Sri Bajarindra. From early childhood the boy was prepared for great achievements for the benefit of a prosperous Siam.
In his youth his father sent him halfway across the globe to the cold Russian Empire. There the exotic prince entered the elite Corps of Pages and quickly became a favorite at the court of Emperor Nicholas II. Chakrabongse graduated with honors and even served in a prestigious hussar regiment. But it was in Saint Petersburg that a meeting occurred which completely turned his life upside down. He fell passionately in love with a young Ukrainian noblewoman named Kateryna Desnytska. The prince secretly married her and brought his blonde wife to tropical Bangkok causing a colossal political and family scandal.
Despite the anger of his parents and alienation from the royal court Chakrabongse continued to serve his homeland faithfully. He became a true innovator and the founder of Siamese military aviation. The prince personally brought the first airplanes to the country and created the powerful Royal Aeronautical Service. Unfortunately his brilliant career ended frighteningly early. The prince contracted severe pneumonia and passed away on June 13 1920 at the age of only 37. He remains forever in history as an outstanding military reformer and the hero of the most beautiful love fairy tale of the early twentieth century.

snippet.title: Princess Diana stole Camilla’s birthday #royal #princess #queen #history
snippet.description:
Princess Diana once stole Camilla's birthday without saying a single word.
In July 1997, Diana learned that Prince Charles was throwing a birthday party for Camilla Parker Bowles at Highgrove.
At the same time, Diana was vacationing in the South of France with Dodi Fayed, knowing paparazzi were following her every move.
So she made a bold decision.
She put on a leopard-print swimsuit and deliberately stepped out where photographers could see her.
The next morning, those photos were splashed across the front pages of newspapers around the world.
Camilla's birthday party barely made the headlines.
One carefully timed appearance—and all the attention was back on Princess Diana.

snippet.title: Why Kate Middleton wears 4 rings #princesscatherine #princewilliam #royal #princess
snippet.description: Why do these 4 rings mean more to Kate Middleton than the royal jewels? The first is an engagement ring with a sapphire set with diamonds. It once belonged to Princess Diana, which makes it a touching symbol of the love, heritage and continuity of the British royal family. The second is the eternity ring from Annoushka Eclipse. Prince William gave it to her for the birth of her first child, Prince George. The third ring is an engagement ring. It is made from a large gold bar mined in Wales, which has been used to make wedding rings for the royal family since 1923. And the fourth sapphire and diamond ring the princess received from William last year after her course of chemotherapy. This Étincelle de Cartier ring is made of platinum, encrusted with 14 diamonds and 14 sapphires.

snippet.title: WATCH: Prince William visits the Apricot Centre
snippet.description:
The Prince of Wales visits the Apricot Centre, a carbon-negative regenerative farm and wellbeing service, to highlight the value of regenerative farming and the role nature can play in supporting mental health and wellbeing.

Set across 120 acres, the Apricot Centre uses organic and regenerative methods including agroforestry, permaculture, rotational grazing and crop rotation. During the visit, Prince William will tour the farm, visit its wellbeing garden and hear how the centre has grown into a financially viable and environmentally pioneering enterprise, increasing biodiversity across the site by 400 per cent.

Join us live to watch King Charles, Queen Camilla and other senior members of the Royal Family attend a Service for the Most Noble Order of the Garter at St George’s Chapel, Windsor Castle.

Looking at the shy 19-year-old, they assumed she couldn't afford the designer clothes and suggested she shop somewhere more "appropriate."
Humiliated, Diana left the store.
But when the owner learned what had happened, he was horrified. He personally reached out to Diana, apologized, and offered to help build her wardrobe.
What happened next was unexpected.
Diana became one of the boutique's most famous clients and went on to turn its designs into royal fashion history.
Sometimes the future Princess of Wales isn't recognized until it's too late. 👑✨

snippet.title: Firefighter Who Heard Princess Diana's Final Words Opened Up What Really Happened To Her
snippet.description:
Firefighter Who Heard Princess Diana's Final Words Opened Up What Really Happened To Her

 French fireman, Xavier Gourmelon, responded to a late night call in August, nineteen ninety-seven—a black Mercedes near the Pont de l'Alma underpass had crashed into another vehicle, supposedly killing all people on impact but then the firefighter saw the blonde lady at the back moving her lips, uttering her last ever words. Xavier immediately knew that the lady was Princess Diana. Join us as we reveal the last words uttered by the people’s princess, Diana..
